en.headline: Man and woman found dead in car near Chi Ma Wan Correctional Institution
en.dek: Police say traces consistent with charcoal burning were found inside the vehicle on a slope opposite the institution; the pair are understood to have been a couple.
body: A man and a woman were found dead inside a private car on a slope opposite Chi Ma Wan Correctional Institution on Lantau Island on Tuesday afternoon.

Police received a report at about 2.04pm after a passer-by noticed the pair appeared unconscious. Fire and ambulance crews attended, broke a window and confirmed both were dead at the scene. Officers found burnt charcoal and a metal basin inside the vehicle. No note was recovered.

According to sources the man, aged 48 and surnamed Wong, was the driver and the woman, aged 47 and surnamed Yeung, was a passenger. They are understood to have been a couple living in the New Territories West. Three Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department staff had noticed the same car parked at the location earlier in the morning but did not approach until the afternoon.
The case is being handled by the district crime squad. Post-mortem examinations are pending and the cause of death remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 芝麻灣懲教所對開斜坡發現男女車內遺體
zh.dek: 警方在車內發現燒過的炭及金屬盆，兩人據悉為情侶；死因有待調查。
body: 大嶼山芝麻灣道333號芝麻灣懲教所對開斜坡，周二下午發現一男一女在私家車內死亡。
警方下午約2時04分接報，有途人發現兩人在車內昏迷。救援人員到場破窗後證實兩人已死亡，車內有燒過的炭及金屬盆，未見遺書。
據悉死者為48歲姓黃男司機及47歲姓楊女乘客，兩人為情侶，同住新界西一帶。今早約8時有三名漁護署職員經過時已見該車停泊，至下午再查看才揭發事件。
案件由當區重案組跟進，死因有待驗屍確定。
